description: This file defines a dispatch mechanism for selecting optimized kernel implementations based on CPU instruction set capabilities and device types. It includes class templates, enums, macros, and functions for managing function pointers for various hardware architectures and device types, primarily used in the PyTorch codebase for runtime dispatching of optimized kernels.

classes.name: DispatchStub
classes.description: Template class for dispatching function pointers based on device type and architecture.

classes.name: DispatchStubImpl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for retrieving and selecting function pointers for different hardware capabilities and device types.

methods.name: get_call_ptr
methods.description: Retrieves the function pointer for a given device type, considering available instruction set optimizations.

methods.name: try_get_call_ptr
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the function pointer for a device type, returning an error variant if not found.

methods.name: try_choose_cpu_impl
methods.description: Selects the best CPU implementation based on available instruction sets, returning an error if none is suitable.

methods.name: choose_cpu_impl
methods.description: Chooses the preferred CPU implementation based on instruction set support.
